title: Ask CoopManage
description: Questions about your cooperative's own records, answered from the database.

field.question: Your question
field.placeholder: How many members do we have?
field.hint: Enter asks. Shift and Enter starts a new line.

plainly.title: Ask plainly
plainly.body: This assistant matches the words in your question against what it can look up. It does not understand language the way a person does, so a short, plain question works best — and everything it can answer is listed below.

empty.title: Ask a question about your cooperative
empty.body: Every answer comes from your cooperative's own records, with the figures beside it and a link to the screen that shows them in full. Nothing is guessed.

refused.title: Nothing here answers that
refused.body: The assistant only reports what is in your cooperative's records. It will not guess, and it cannot reach anything your role does not cover. The list below is everything it can answer.

canAsk.title: What you can ask
canAsk.body: This list is yours: it covers only what your role lets you see. Select one to put it in the box.

tools.countMembers: How many members are on the register, and how many are active
tools.membersWithoutPhone: How many members have no phone number, so cannot be reached by SMS
tools.contributionsTotal: What members contributed over a period
tools.financeFlows: Money in and out over a period
tools.topExpenseCategories: What the cooperative spent most on over a period
tools.lowStockProducts: Which products are at or below their minimum
tools.stockOnHand: How much of one product is in the store
tools.salesTotal: What was sold over a period
tools.openDecisions: Which actions agreed at a meeting are still open

examples.countMembers: How many members do we have?
examples.membersWithoutPhone: How many members have no phone number?
examples.contributionsTotal: How much did members contribute this month?
examples.financeFlows: How much came in and went out this month?
examples.topExpenseCategories: What did we spend most on this month?
examples.lowStockProducts: What is running low in the store?
examples.stockOnHand: How much fertiliser is in the store?
examples.salesTotal: How much did we sell this month?
examples.outstandingFromBuyers: What do buyers still owe us?

answer.countMembers: The register holds {{total}} members, of whom {{active}} are active.
answer.membersWithoutPhone_one: One of your {{active}} active members has no phone number, so an SMS will not reach them.
answer.membersWithoutPhone: {{count}} of your {{active}} active members have no phone number, so an SMS will not reach them.
answer.contributionsTotal_one: One contribution of {{amount}} was recorded between {{from}} and {{to}}.
answer.contributionsTotal: Members contributed {{amount}} across {{count}} contributions between {{from}} and {{to}}.
answer.financeFlows: Between {{from}} and {{to}}, {{income}} came in and {{expenses}} went out.
answer.topExpenseCategories: The largest expense between {{from}} and {{to}} was {{category}}, at {{amount}}.
answer.lowStockProducts_one: One product is at or below its minimum: {{product}}.
answer.lowStockProducts: {{count}} products are at or below their minimum, starting with {{product}}.
answer.lowStockProducts.none: Every product is above its minimum.
answer.stockOnHand.noSuchProduct: There is no product called {{name}} in the catalogue.
answer.salesTotal_one: One sale of {{sold}} was confirmed between {{from}} and {{to}}.
answer.salesTotal: {{sold}} was sold across {{count}} sales between {{from}} and {{to}}.
answer.outstandingFromBuyers_one: {{amount}} is still owed, by {{buyer}}, from a sale on {{since}}.
answer.outstandingFromBuyers: {{amount}} is still owed across {{count}} sales, the oldest by {{buyer}} from {{since}}.
answer.openDecisions_one: One action agreed at a meeting is still open, and {{overdue}} of them is past its due date.
answer.openDecisions: {{count}} actions agreed at meetings are still open, {{overdue}} of them past their due date.
answer.openDecisions.none: Every action agreed at a meeting has been closed.

refusal.noToolFits: I cannot answer that from your cooperative's records.
refusal.notAQuestion: I did not find a question there.
refusal.badArguments: I understood the question but could not work out what to look up.
